facts: 17-axis main body with five-axis central projection and six fluted Corinthian columns; pilasters behind them
Wing fronts repeat a simplified pilaster order
Rusticated base, fine plaster joints, arched principal-floor windows with botanical garlands and keystone heads
Postwar replica central roof figures and relocated additions on side projections; no new sculptural count inferred
Universitäts-Hauptgebäude UL 6; Unter den Linden 6, Berlin-Mitte
Restored portal bore the Humboldt Universität name in October 1951; pre-existing model inscription is retained unchanged

newDetail: Six existing column shafts receive shallow tapered flute shadow strips; no shaft or column is duplicated
Two bounded acanthus/volute tiers articulate existing capitals; rear pilasters are aligned with existing columns
Finer cornice dentils, upper plaster joints, fanlight bars and sill brackets follow eleven exact measured facade planes
Central arch keystones and procedural botanical swags supplement existing wing keystone heads
Small turned baluster bellies refine existing square spindles; robe folds supplement existing roof figures without new figures
Two main entrance leaves receive recessed panels and paired handles, retaining existing glazing/transom/frame and open forecourt
accuracy: All local relief dimensions, leaf arrangements, fluting count and pane subdivisions are procedural estimates. Measured source walls, roof, open court and previous complete geometry remain unchanged. Free image is visual QA only; no photographic pixel, colour sample, protected font or relief tracing is copied.
native: Independent orthogonal ornament batch; fine plaster grooves remain a drawn surface cue while native geometry emphasizes capitals, garlands, doors and balustrades. No smooth overlay survives in Minecraft.
